items.title: Show HN: I made some transistor animations
items.titleZh: Show HN：我制作了一些晶体管动画
items.summary:
Hi HN,
I made some animations of the most important kinds of transistors using my semiconductor simulation, details of which are on the page. I tried to make the visuals as realistic as possible while also aiming for clarity. If you want to go beyond the charge carriers and look at, for example, the electric field, you can do so in the simulation software. The desktop software also has less common devices like IBGTs and SCRs that have similar animations. The last thread about my software was posted here about a year ago: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=43942279

 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49039868

 Points: 13

 # Comments: 1
items.summaryZh:
嗨，HN，
我使用半导体模拟制作了一些最重要的晶体管类型的动画，详细信息在页面上。我试图使视觉效果尽可能真实，同时也追求清晰度。如果您想要超越电荷载流子并查看电场等内容，您可以在仿真软件中执行此操作。桌面软件还具有不太常见的设备，例如具有类似动画的 IBGT 和 SCR。关于我的软件的最后一个帖子大约一年前发布在这里：https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=43942279
